senses.gloss:
उलूक उलूक, m.
 1. An owl, Bhartṛ. 2, 89.
 2. A name of Indra, Chr. 46, 26.
 3. The name of a country, its people (plur.), and its king, MBh. 1, 335, etc.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Lat. ulula; A.S. and O.H.G. ûla.
उलूखल उलूखल (cf. उदूखल), n. A mortar, Pañc. 249, 8.
ऽउलूखलिक -उलूखलिक, i. e. उलूखल + इक, adj. A substitute for the last, when latter part of comp. adj., e. g. दन्त-, adj. One who uses his teeth as a mortar or pestle, Man. 6, 17.
ऽउलूखलिन् -उलूखलिन्, i. e. उलूखल + इन्, in दन्त-, adj. Using his teeth as a mortar or pestle, Rām. 1, 52, 26 Gorr.
उल्लुञ्चन उल्लुञ्चन, i. e. उद्-लुञ्च् + अन, n. Pulling, Yājñ. 2, 217.
